# Copilot instructions

This repository is a curated awesome-list; `README.md` is the product. The shared agent contract lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), and the entry rules live in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Read both before reviewing or editing, and follow them over any generic awesome-list convention.

This file is deliberately a pointer, so the rules exist in one place and cannot drift.
